context_loaded.detail: 2 comments, no new facts beyond description

requirements.summary: Bulk CSV export for OKR custom fields

acceptance_criteria.text: User can select which custom fields to include before exporting.
Export completes in a reasonable time and downloads automatically.

findings.excerpt_quote: Export completes in a reasonable time and downloads automatically.
findings.finding_summary: AC says export must complete "in a reasonable time" — no threshold stated.
findings.testing_impact: Cannot define a pass/fail latency assertion.

findings.finding_summary: Failure AC exists ("show an error") but not what the message says or whether retry is possible.
findings.testing_impact: Cannot write the negative-path assertion or a retry test.

findings.finding_summary: No statement of which roles can trigger a bulk export (all users? admins only?).
findings.testing_impact: Permission-boundary tests cannot be scoped yet.

findings.finding_summary: No accessibility note for the export progress indicator.
findings.testing_impact: Low impact on initial scope; worth a follow-up question only.

questions.question: What does "reasonable time" mean for the export, in seconds or a row-count-scaled budget?
questions.context: AC-02 uses the phrase with no number.

questions.question: If a field mapping errors mid-export, does the partial file download anyway, or is it withheld entirely — and can the user retry?
questions.context: Failure behaviour and retry are undefined.

questions.question: Is bulk export available to all authenticated users, or restricted to Admins?
questions.context: No role stated anywhere in analyzed sources.

automation_candidate.rationale: Assertions for latency and failure handling are undefined.

qa_readiness_checklist.check: Field selection UI includes/excludes fields correctly before export
Export completes within the confirmed time budget
Failure shows the confirmed message and retry path
Field-level permission is enforced per row in the exported CSV

report.readiness_line: 2 High findings (RR-DEMO-4522-01, RR-DEMO-4522-02) and 2 open High questions (Q1, Q2) stand between this story and test design.

facts.text: Feature adds a "Bulk export" action on the OKR custom-fields list view.
Export format is CSV, generated server-side.
Reuses the existing field-mapping service used by the single-record export.
AC-01: "User can select which custom fields to include before exporting."
AC-02: "Export completes in a reasonable time and downloads automatically."

not_stated: Numeric or scaled time budget for "reasonable time."
Which roles may trigger a bulk export.
Whether a partially-failed export downloads a partial file or nothing.

risks.text: Bulk export touches the same field-mapping service as the single-record export — regression surface if mapping logic is shared.
Exported CSV may contain values from custom fields with restricted visibility — data integrity/permissions risk if the export doesn't re-check field-level permissions per row.
risks.source: Gap analysis — no statement either way

testing_focus.text: Verify export completion time once a numeric budget is confirmed.
Verify the failure message text and retry behaviour once defined.
Verify field-level permission enforcement on every exported row, regardless of who triggers the export.

epic_context.text: DEMO-4500 — "OKR custom fields, phase 2" — In Progress.
Epic goal: "let teams get their custom-field data out of the product for reporting." No factual inconsistency found between epic and story text.

report.next_action: Ask the PM Q1 and the EM Q2, then rescan DEMO-4522. The Creator can start now on AC-01 if the team prefers to draft in parallel.
